arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Palmer argued formality determines the statement's legal status.
Mr. Van Hoek argued past crime reports can imply ongoing emergencies.
Justice Scalia rejected formality as the deciding factor.
Justice Sotomayor emphasized the declarant's primary purpose matters.
